body.name: computed closure and valid-sequence fixing transition
body.construction:
The relation \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}}\) implements computed closure and fixing.  For a district \(D^{*}\), compute \(C=\operatorname{closure}_{G_H^{[]}}(D^{*})\) and the returned sequence
\(\pi_C=\operatorname{fixSeq}_{G_H^{[]}}(V\setminus C)\).  If \(C=D^{*}\), execute the returned sequence stepwise on \((G_H^{[]},p_H)\), choose the least \(s\in L(D^{*})\), evaluate the kernel at \(S=s\) and at the required coordinates of \(a\), and create \(\operatorname{Factor}(D^{*},q_{D^{*}},s)\).  If \(C\ne D^{*}\), execute \(\pi_C\) to obtain exactly
\[
 \widetilde G=\phi_{V\setminus C}(G_H^{[]}),\qquad
 \widetilde q=\phi_{V\setminus C}(p_H;G_H^{[]}).
\]
If \(S\notin C\), enumerate \(s\in L(D^{*})\), compute \(\widetilde G[s]\), and test \(\operatorname{fixSeq}_{\widetilde G[s]}(C\setminus D^{*})\).  The first successful context is executed and emits
\[
 q_{D^{*}}=\phi_{C\setminus D^{*}}(\widetilde q;\widetilde G[s]).
\]
If none succeeds, record \(\operatorname{LGSFailThicket}(D^{*},C)\) and create its residual task.  If \(S\in C\), create the Algorithm-2 task.  A \(\operatorname{Fix}(G,q,T,\mathrm{continuation})\) task always uses the already computed least valid sequence, processes one member, records its actual conditional and cross-multiplied successor identity, and then either recurs on the shorter sequence or invokes its continuation.
